body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics introduced ‘55PB2DR’, a 55-inch PDP TV equipped with two hours of automatic ''time machine'' feature, which allows users to pause, record and reply TV programs for two hours after the original broadcast with a built-in DVR.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
